conflict.description: Merged PR #120 explicitly assigns dispatcher release-barrier policy, dispatcher documentation/templates, and deterministic tests to RECON-010, but the generated RECON-010 plan entry retained a narrower documentation/evidence-only write scope. Implementing the amendment without first reconciling this conflict would be an unauthorized scope expansion.

authority_resolution.mechanism: repository replan/control-plane amendment with append-only authority evidence and fail-closed effective-scope validation
authority_resolution.plan_fingerprint_policy: Preserve the installed plan fingerprint and historical BOOT-000 attestation. Do not rewrite sealed bootstrap evidence. Represent the one-time merged amendment as a separately validated control-plane authority amendment bound to RECON-010 and PR #120.
constraints: The static DAG and existing completion requirements remain unchanged.
The amendment may only expand effective authority for RECON-010 and only to the enumerated files.
The existing RECON reconciliation evidence and prior receipt commit remain immutable history.
A new candidate and new zero-path durable receipt must cover the complete amended diff.

roles.reason: The merged amendment is binding repository history, but the generated node scope must be reconciled before implementation.
Repository inspection confirms the release-barrier text exists in merged PR #120 but not in the current Autopilot policy/controller surface.
A separately validated, exact-path authority amendment preserves fail-closed scope enforcement without rewriting BOOT-000 or weakening receipt validation.

rollback: Revert the amended RECON candidate/PR commits while retaining this adverse authority-reconciliation record and the prior receipt commit in branch history.
